question: In a clinical study to evaluate the efficacy of a new medication in the treatment of migraine crisis (point out the CORRECT):

options.opa: Strict inclusion criteria increase the external validity of the study.
options.opb: Strict exclusion criteria reduce the internal validity of the study.
options.opc: Control with a placebo arm increases the external validity of the study.
options.opd: Masking reduces the internal validity of the study.
options.ope: Randomization increases the internal validity of the study.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Strict inclusion criteria -> more homogeneous study population -> increased internal validity -> 80% CHAIN: Strict exclusion criteria -> reduced confounding variables -> increased internal validity -> 85% CHAIN: Control with a placebo arm -> allows for comparison -> increased internal validity -> 90% CHAIN: Masking -> reduces bias -> increased internal validity -> 85% CHAIN: Randomization -> minimizes selection bias -> increased internal validity -> 80%
